title: ui-locked: create completion summary
description: Create a completion summary component that displays the final results of the Progressive Discover workflow. Shows compiled artifact statistics, quality metrics, confidence scores, and actions available for the locked artifacts.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display comprehensive completion summary
THE SYSTEM SHALL show all compiled artifact statistics

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the completion summary with all artifact statistics

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user clicks on an artifact
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL display detailed information for that artifact

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display misleading statistics
unwanted.because: Users need accurate information about their artifacts

unwanted.condition: IF artifact details fail to load
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash or show blank sections

postconditions: Complete summary is displayed with all statistics
Users can access individual artifact details
Actions are available for next steps
invariants: Summary remains stable after initial render

happy: Given locked phase is active, when summary renders, then all artifact statistics are visible
Given summary is displayed, when user clicks artifact, then detail panel opens with full information
Given compilation produced 15 artifacts, when summary shows, then count displays 15 artifacts
error: Given statistics calculation fails, when summary renders, then fallback message with partial data is shown
Given artifact detail fails to load, when user clicks, then error message appears in detail panel
Given quality metrics unavailable, when summary renders, then metrics section shows unavailable state
